# NEEDLE adapter usage fixture: aider's end-of-run token summary lines.
# Shape verified against Aider-AI/aider@main on 2026-09-26 (no released CLI
# was installed for a live recording):
#   aider/coders/base_coder.py assembles
#     "Tokens: {format_tokens(sent)} sent"
#       + optional ", {format_tokens(n)} cache write"
#       + optional ", {format_tokens(n)} cache hit"
#       + ", {format_tokens(received)} received."
#   and aider/utils.py format_tokens prints counts below 1,000 in full and
#   abbreviates larger ones to "1.5k" / "15k".
# The adapter smoke matrix replays this fixture without invoking Aider.
# Line 1 is the cached form every Anthropic-model session prints (prompt
# caching is on by default); line 2 the uncached form; line 3 the sub-1,000
# edge case. The parser takes the first parseable line.
Tokens: 12.5k sent, 8.1k cache write, 2.1k cache hit, 4.3k received.
Tokens: 3.2k sent, 1.1k received.
Tokens: 850 sent, 120 received.
